locks.statement: Exactly one scope: CEG graph health and enrichment feedback through Gate to EIE. No Offer Drafting, Web Lead PR329, Odoo Semantic Kernel, CRM writeback, payment, sales or procurement work.
Current intended deployment is DISABLED. No environment variable or deployed configuration is changed by this pack. Eventual enablement needs fresh explicit release/operator approval.
Code-level defaults for HEALTH_API_ENABLED, AUTO_ENRICH_VIA_GATE and GRAPH_INFERENCE_FEEDBACK_ENABLED remain false for fail-closed rollback.
Health assessment/report is read-only. Public/canonical health-assess calls cannot incur paid enrichment side effects merely by viewing health.
CEG exclusively owns health assessment, due entity discovery, ROI ordering and bounded scheduler. No additional Odoo health selector or local inference engine.
Gate is the only CEG-to-EIE routing authority. `health-assess` is CEG-owned; `enrich` and `graph-inference-result` remain EIE-owned. No CEG->EIE direct peer call or worker impersonation.
Tenant identity is canonical: signed packet tenant == domain id == Neo4j database; no payload override or cross-company/tenant data traversal.
No job is dispatched without explicit current tenant/field allowlist, bounded queue/rate, source freshness, provider budget authorization and operation state.
ROI estimates are advisory and cannot authorize paid spend alone. Existing assumed $1,000 deal value/expected improvement is not calibrated commercial evidence.
Durable identity and recovery must cover operation+input revision+tenant+target fields. Retried, reordered or repeated jobs cannot multiply paid work or resurrect stale data.
Transport acknowledgement, EIE accepted/durable result, graph sync and measured CEG health reassessment are different states; report each accurately.

Graph-inference feedback is attributable, tenant-bound, rule-versioned, confidence-filtered, bounded and consumed on an authorized convergence pass; no inference from the result can recursively self-trigger indefinite work.
EIE return-channel acceptance cannot silently discard work on queue-full, process restart or multi-worker routing; recoverable disposition is required before automation.
Disable must stop new paid requests, scheduled jobs and retries without erasing evidence; read-only health may be disabled independently if unsafe.
No activation based on unit mocks, feature flags printed true, an HTTP 200, queue length or a single packet. A real two-node Gate route, persistence and health change must be proven.

Scope includes only minimal required changes at authoritative source owners. Reuse Gate SDK and existing scheduling/evidence storage when sufficient; no new framework, transport or infrastructure by default.
Existing unrelated controls remain: health commercial tiers, GDPR erasure, unvalidated/dormant domain pack admission, legacy chassis and direct peer ingress are NOT enabled.
Source-owner approval, accepted ADRs, independent code review, runtime tests and exact deployment configuration are separate from this planning document. Unknown never counts as proof.
